newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania to issue five new coins next year.
newsitem.headline: Albania to issue five new coins next year.

text.p: Albania's central bank is to issue five new coins to complement the introduction of new price structures, a central bank official said on Tuesday.
"The new coins will be issued to better serve the new price structure and make payments easier," the central bank official told Reuters. The coins would be legal tender from January 1.

Five types of coins with the value of one, five, 10, 20 and 50 leks (50 cents) will replace existing smaller notes of one, three, five, 10 and 50 leks. The introduction of a 100 lek coin is planned at a later stage. ($1=101 Lek)
